x: A is correct: AP Police signed an MoU with IIT Tirupati for a Cyber Crime Investigation and Training Academy focused on digital forensics and blockchain tracing. It was not set up by the ITU or the Supreme Court, and it is not a malware research centre under the AP Cyber Security Policy 2017.
APTS (Andhra Pradesh Technology Services) monitors the State's Critical Government Infrastructure through APCSOC and has audited 270 GoAP applications. CERT-In, I4C and MeitY are national bodies.

Only pair a is correct: CyTrain gives online training to police, prosecutors and judges. The Cybercrime Forensic Lab Consortium is a forensic-lab component of I4C (the financial-fraud helpline is 1930); CFCFRMS freezes defrauded funds in real time (data sharing is Samanvaya); takedown notices are issued through SAHYOG, not the Reporting Portal. So a only.

Section 79 gives intermediaries safe harbour, lost if they fail to act on 'actual knowledge'. After Shreya Singhal (2015), actual knowledge means a court order or a government notice, not a private complaint, a service delay or an advertisement.

G. Madhavan Nair (2003-09) is matched with Chandrayaan-1. Mangalyaan was under K. Radhakrishnan (2009-14), not A.S. Kiran Kumar; PSLV became operational in 1994 under K. Kasturirangan, not K. Sivan; and the 104-satellite PSLV launch (2017) was under A.S. Kiran Kumar, not K. Radhakrishnan.

M.G.K. Menon was ISRO Chairman briefly in 1972. S. Somanath served 2022-25 (the 104-satellite PSLV of 2017 was under A.S. Kiran Kumar, 2015-18); 2003-09 and Chandrayaan-1 belong to G. Madhavan Nair, not U.R. Rao; 1994-2003 and the GSLV first flight belong to K. Kasturirangan, not K. Sivan.
